meta.title: TNS AI Documentation Portal
meta.description: User guides and technical documentation for the TNS AI applications suite: EcoData, EcoLab, Finco, VietLOD, and SachKTL.

hero.title: TNS AI Documentation
hero.subtitle: Comprehensive user guides and tutorials empowering faculty, quantitative researchers, financial analysts, and graduate students across the TNS AI data and econometrics ecosystem.

steps.title: EcoData
steps.description: Explore harmonized international and Vietnam macro and micro series across 34/63 provinces, VHLSS, PCI, corporate financials, 201 Tri-Engine econometric models, and the 52-tool Unified MCP Server.

steps.title: EcoLab
steps.description: Execute a closed-loop 5-stage quantitative research pipeline featuring 201 econometric models across 15 families, 6-source DOI-verified literature synthesis, and 5-gate evidence-locked manuscripts.

steps.title: Finco
steps.description: Query Vietnamese equities, deep financial statement notes, 3,448 MXV commodity indicators, 19 global main markets, and 138 StockMCP quantitative investment tools.

steps.title: VietLOD
steps.description: Master step-by-step How-To implementation guides for all 201 econometric models across 15 chapters and 58 methodological groups in Stata 18 MP, R 4.x, and Python 3.11+.

steps.title: SachKTL
steps.description: Digital academic textbook library featuring 30 quantitative textbooks (503 chapters, 2,650 detailed lessons) alongside 4 Applied Econometrics courses structured across 4 proficiency levels.

sources.title: Documentation Directory
sources.description: Select an application below to view detailed operational guides, methodological workflows, and step-by-step execution instructions.

items.title: EcoData User Guide
items.description: Learn how to search 34/63-province indicators, estimate 201 Tri-Engine econometric models, operate 2-stage model curation, and connect the 52-tool Unified MCP Server.

items.title: EcoLab User Guide
items.description: Learn the 5-stage empirical research pipeline, 201 econometric models across 15 families, Zero-Copy EcoData transfers, and publication-grade manuscript generation.

items.title: Finco User Guide
items.description: Learn how to extract equities, financial notes, MXV commodities, 19 main markets, Vietnam macro series, 2-sheet SPSS exports, and 138 StockMCP investment tools.

items.title: VietLOD User Guide
items.description: Explore step-by-step How-To guides across 15 chapters, 58 methodological groups, and 201 econometric models with Stata 18, R 4.x, Python 3.11+ scripts, CSV datasets, and convergence plots.

items.title: SachKTL User Guide
items.description: Explore step-by-step How-To guides across all 30 econometrics, R, Python, Stata, time-series, and spatial textbooks (503 chapters, 2,650 lessons) and 4 structured courses.

tools.title: AI-Powered Quantitative Research and Investment Analytics
tools.description: The TNS AI ecosystem unifies macroeconomic data, financial market feeds, and econometric methodology to accelerate reproducible academic and investment research.

items.title: 201 Econometric Models
items.description: Execute and cross-verify 201 econometric specifications across 15 chapters and 58 groups simultaneously in Stata 18 MP, R 4.x, and Python 3.11+.

items.title: 138 StockMCP Tools
items.description: Automate 360-degree stock diagnostics, multi-model valuation, 4-horizon strategy planning, and quantitative backtesting on Finco.

items.title: SPSS & Q1 Journal Exports
items.description: Export 2-sheet SPSS-ready workbooks and reproducible replication bundles across EcoData, Finco, and EcoLab.

cookieBanner.title: Cookie Preferences and Personal Data Protection
cookieBanner.desc: The TNS AI Documentation Portal uses essential cookies for language and interface state. Analytics scripts run only after explicit opt-in consent under Personal Data Protection Law 91/2025/QH15.
